<h2>Load Value from Active Configuration</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Loads one nested value from the active project configuration.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_active_config_value(value, file = here::here("config.yml"))
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="value">value</code></td>
<td>
<p>A character vector specifying the configuration key(s) to retrieve.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="file">file</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the YAML configuration file (default: &quot;config.yml&quot;).</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The active configuration is set by 'R_CONFIG_ACTIVE'. An unset or empty
value uses 'default'. Explicit named access belongs in [load_config()] or
[load_config_value()].
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The value associated with the specified key path.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[load_config()], [load_config_value()]
</p>

</main>
